blocks.text: CEBU, PHILIPPINES —The Miss Asia Pacific International pageant will celebrate its 58th anniversary edition at the Grand Coronation Night that will be staged at Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City on Saturday evening, Oct. 10. For the 2026 edition of the oldest and longest-running international beauty pageant founded in the Philippines, 38 delegates from different countries and territories around the world will be competing to succeed reigning queen Isabela Fernandes from Brazil. The international pageant organization has not yet revealed the official competition format for the Grand Coronation Night on Saturday, but it was already announced earlier that the Best in National […]...
